chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Whoever seeks this world and the Hereafter, let him set out for this House."

key_terms.الْبَيْتَ: the Sacred House, meaning the Ka'bah

ai.seo_question: How does hajj benefit both this world and the Hereafter?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages turning toward the Sacred House for the sake of both worldly and otherworldly good. It presents hajj as a source of benefit in worldly life and a means to attain reward in the Hereafter.
